ACTION: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
FATHER THOMAS: "A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."
CATHERINE: "Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."
CATHERINE: "Name your price."
FATHER THOMAS: "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
CATHERINE: "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
FATHER THOMAS: "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
CATHERINE: "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
